name: GHESSA
tagline: Empowering youth and professionals across Nigeria through advanced IT and tech education
intro: In commemoration of Nigeria's 66th Independence Anniversary, GHESSA (Grassroot Humanitarian Empowerment Support), in strategic collaboration with Aptech Computer Education, is sponsoring a nationwide IT scholarship scheme designed to equip Nigerian youth and working adults with high-demand digital skills.

objectives.title: Digital skill empowerment
objectives.description: Provide subsidised, industry-aligned IT education to bridge the digital skills gap across local communities.

objectives.title: Career acceleration
objectives.description: Equip participants with workforce-ready technical expertise in modern technology domains.

objectives.title: Higher education pathways
objectives.description: Create seamless progression routes toward internationally recognised professional diplomas and university degrees.

objectives.title: Socio-economic growth
objectives.description: Promote employment and youth entrepreneurship through practical technical training and certification.

tracks.focus: MS Office suite, document management, productivity tools
Excel analytics, data visualisation, BI fundamentals
Network fundamentals, threat defence, security principles
Core logic, data structures, automation and scripting

tracks.target: Modern web design and front-end development

tracksNote: Additional specialised tracks including Database Administration, Graphic Design and Networking are also accessible under the programme.
pathwayIntro: Beyond the short-term course, this scholarship creates a direct progression toward advanced professional qualifications and tertiary degrees through Aptech's international credit transfer framework.

pathwayDetails.title: Short-term skill acquisition
pathwayDetails.description: Candidates who complete the introductory modules qualify for merit evaluation into advanced specialisation tracks.

pathwayDetails.title: Advanced Diploma in Software Engineering (ADSE)
pathwayDetails.description: Top performers receive eligibility for full or partial scholarship slots into Aptech's flagship multi-semester ADSE programme.

pathwayDetails.title: Credit transfer for HND / B.Sc.
pathwayDetails.description: ADSE graduates can use Aptech's credit transfer tie-ups with overseas partner universities (UK, Australia and others) to complete a B.Sc. or HND in reduced time and cost.

eligibility.title: Who can apply?
eligibility.description: Open to Nigerian citizens, students, secondary school graduates, job seekers and working professionals seeking modern IT competencies.

eligibility.title: Application requirements
eligibility.description: A basic interest in technology. Candidates complete the online registration and select their preferred accredited Aptech centre.

eligibility.title: How to enrol
eligibility.description: Register online, pay the scholarship form fee, then sit the entrance assessment at your centre. Your form and exam date are issued once the fee is confirmed.

partnerWhy: GHESSA is a Grassroot Humanitarian Empowerment Support initiative committed to youth upliftment and educational empowerment across Nigeria.
aptechWhy: Aptech Computer Education is a premier global IT training institution with over 30 years of excellence in skill-based education across 40+ countries.
apcWhy: AI Projects LTD runs the application, payment and exam scheduling for the programme through AI Project Connect.
